Ardoz, Cobbler of War.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever Ardoz or another creature you control enters, that creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
{3}{R}: Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token with haste. Activate only as a sorcery.

Bolt Hound.oracle_text:
Haste (This creature can attack and {T} as soon as it comes under your control.)
Whenever this creature attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

Chandra's Pyreling.oracle_text: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains double strike until end of turn. (It deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.)

Chandra's Pyrohelix.oracle_text: Chandra's Pyrohelix deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.

Disciple of Perdition.oracle_text:
When this creature dies, choose one. If you have exactly 13 life, you may choose both instead.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• Exile target opponent's graveyard. That player loses 1 life.

Fiery Conclusion.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Fiery Conclusion deals 5 damage to target creature.

Fiery Intervention.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Fiery Intervention deals 5 damage to target creature.
• Destroy target artifact.

Goblin Researcher.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. During any turn you attacked with this creature, you may play that card.

Markov Warlord.oracle_text:
Haste (This creature can attack and {T} as soon as it comes under your control.)
When this creature enters, up to two target creatures can't block this turn.

Rookie Mistake.oracle_text: Until end of turn, target creature gets +0/+2 and another target creature gets -2/-0.

Spiteful Prankster.oracle_text:
During your turn, this creature has first strike.
Whenever another creature dies, this creature deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.

Thriving Bluff.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than red.
{T}: Add {R} or one mana of the chosen color.

Thriving Isle.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than blue.
{T}: Add {U} or one mana of the chosen color.

Tide Skimmer.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you attack with two or more creatures with flying, draw a card.

Unsubstantiate.oracle_text: Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.

Wakedancer.oracle_text: Morbid — When this creature enters, if a creature died this turn, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

Warden of Evos Isle.oracle_text:
Flying
Creature spells with flying you cast cost {1} less to cast.

Wildfire Elemental.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

Chandra, Flame's Fury.oracle_text:
+1: Chandra deals 2 damage to any target.
−2: Chandra deals 4 damage to target creature and 2 damage to that creature's controller.
−8: Chandra deals 10 damage to target player and each creature that player controls.

Irreverent Revelers.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, choose one —
• Destroy target artifact.
• This creature gains haste until end of turn.

Sacrifice a creature: Put a charge counter on this artifact.
{1}, Remove two charge counters from this artifact: Create a 2/2 colorless Spawn artifact creature token.

annotations.description: Kept a 7-card hand with 6 lands and only 1 spell (Warden of Evos Isle). This hand has virtually no early game pressure or interaction, and will likely lead to flooding out while the opponent develops their board.
annotations.betterLine: Mulligan to 6 cards. A random 6-card hand with a scry is far more likely to have a functional mix of lands and spells than this hand, which is almost entirely mana-flooded from the start.

annotations.description: Playing Swamp when the hand contains no black spells. All castable cards (Tide Skimmer, Warden of Evos Isle) require blue mana. The Swamp produces only off-color mana that serves no purpose given the current hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Swamp as the land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Isle (choosing black for flexibility) which still produces blue mana for future blue spells, or play a basic Island for untapped blue mana. Thriving Isle is the best choice since it covers blue + a secondary color.

annotations.description: Cast Tide Skimmer (4 mana) instead of Warden of Evos Isle (3 mana). Warden would have reduced Tide Skimmer's cost by {1} next turn, allowing better mana efficiency and getting both flyers out faster. With Warden out, Tide Skimmer costs only {2}{U}, leaving more mana open. Additionally, both flyers together would trigger Tide Skimmer's card draw ability when attacking. Also failed to play a land before casting.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Tide Skimmer for {3}{U} using all 4 available mana
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Isle (choosing a color), then cast Warden of Evos Isle for {2}{U} (3 mana), leaving 1 mana open. Next turn, cast Tide Skimmer for {2}{U} (discounted) and have two flyers ready to trigger card draw.

annotations.description: Discarded Chandra, Flame's Fury — a 6-mana bomb planeswalker that is likely the most powerful card in their entire deck. With 2 Mountains in hand and only needing to reach 6 lands, Chandra was very castable within a few turns and would dominate the board once resolved.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Chandra, Flame's Fury to hand size.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Fiery Conclusion (requires sacrificing a creature, which is a real cost with limited board presence) or Irreverent Revelers (a mediocre 2/2 for 3 with situational artifact destruction). Keep Chandra as the highest-impact card in hand.

annotations.description: Playing Island instead of Thriving Isle when only 4 mana is needed this turn (to cast Warden of Evos Isle at 2U). Thriving Isle enters tapped but that doesn't matter since the 5th untapped land isn't needed. Playing Thriving Isle (choosing black) would provide a second black source for future turns, improving mana flexibility for Wakedancer and other black spells.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Island as the land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Isle (choosing black) as the land drop, then cast Warden of Evos Isle with the 4 untapped lands. This preserves Islands in hand for future turns when untapped mana might matter more, while gaining a second black source.

annotations.description: Using Rookie Mistake just to reduce Ardoz's attack damage by 2 this turn (from 3 to 1) while at 20 life is a low-value use of a combat trick. The -2/-0 and +2/+0 mostly cancel out, and the +0/+2 on the tapped Tide Skimmer does nothing meaningful right now.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Rookie Mistake in response to Ardoz's ETB trigger to give Ardoz -2/-0 and Tide Skimmer +0/+2
annotations.betterLine: Save Rookie Mistake for a future combat where it can save a creature from dying or create a favorable trade. At 20 life, preventing 2 damage is not worth spending a card.

annotations.description: Cast Irreverent Revelers (2/2, choosing haste which Ardoz already provides) for 3 mana instead of Goblin Researcher or Wildfire Elemental for 4 mana. Both 4-mana options would enter as 5/3 with haste (from Ardoz), dealing 1 more damage this turn and leaving a bigger body. Goblin Researcher also provides card advantage via its exile trigger. The Revelers' haste mode is redundant with Ardoz on board, and its artifact destruction mode has no target.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Irreverent Revelers for 3 mana, leaving 1 Mountain unused
annotations.betterLine: Cast Goblin Researcher for 4 mana, entering as a 5/3 with haste (from Ardoz), dealing more damage and getting a card exiled for future use

annotations.description: GptOSS Vet declined to block when they could have blocked Ardoz (1/1) with Tide Skimmer (2/3) for free — Tide Skimmer survives the combat, Ardoz dies, and they take 4 damage instead of 5. Ardoz is a key engine piece that gives +2/+0 to every entering creature and grants haste, making it a high-priority removal target. Killing it for free while taking less damage is pure upside.
annotations.actionTaken: No blocks, taking 5 damage (1 from Ardoz + 4 from Revelers) and leaving Ardoz alive.
annotations.betterLine: Block Ardoz with Tide Skimmer. Tide Skimmer (2/3) easily survives Ardoz's 1 power, Ardoz dies, and only 4 damage is taken from the unblocked Revelers. This eliminates the opponent's creature-buffing engine for free.

annotations.description: GPT52 Timmy declined to attack with any creatures despite having Fiery Conclusion in hand as a combat trick. Attacking with both creatures would force the opponent to block one with Tide Skimmer, allowing GPT52 to sacrifice the blocked creature to Fiery Conclusion to kill the Tide Skimmer (their only creature) while pushing damage through with the unblocked attacker. Not attacking preserves Tide Skimmer and maintains no board pressure against a 12-life opponent.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed combat without declaring any attackers.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Ardoz and Irreverent Revelers. If opponent blocks one with Tide Skimmer, sacrifice the blocked creature to Fiery Conclusion targeting Tide Skimmer (5 damage kills it), and deal damage with the unblocked creature. This removes the opponent's only threat while advancing the clock.

annotations.description: Cast Warden of Evos Isle before playing a land drop. With 5 untapped lands and a land drop remaining, playing a land first (e.g., Thriving Isle choosing black, or an Island) would have given 6 mana total, enabling casting both Warden of Evos Isle (3 mana) and Wakedancer (3 mana) or Spawning Pit (2 mana) in the same turn. By casting Warden first, auto-tap might use the Swamp, preventing Wakedancer from being cast afterward.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Warden of Evos Isle without first making a land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play a land first (Thriving Isle choosing black, or an Island), then cast Warden of Evos Isle and Wakedancer (or Spawning Pit) to deploy multiple threats while at a precarious 12 life against three opposing creatures.

annotations.description: GPT52 Timmy passed on the opportunity to cast Fiery Conclusion to destroy Tide Skimmer (2/3 flying) before Warden of Evos Isle resolves. Once Warden resolves, the opponent has two flyers that trigger Tide Skimmer's card draw ability whenever they attack together. This flying card-draw engine is very threatening against Timmy's ground-based creatures, which can't block flyers. The opponent is at 12 life but the flying pressure plus card advantage could easily swing the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, allowing Warden of Evos Isle to resolve without killing Tide Skimmer
annotations.betterLine: Cast Fiery Conclusion sacrificing Irreverent Revelers (the least impactful creature) to deal 5 damage to Tide Skimmer, destroying the opponent's key flying threat and preventing the card-draw engine with the incoming Warden of Evos Isle.

annotations.description: Player declined to block with Warden of Evos Isle despite taking 9 damage to drop to 3 life against an aggressive red deck. Blocking Bolt Hound would trade the Warden (2/2) for Bolt Hound AND remove its +1/+0 buff from the other attackers, saving 4 total damage (going to 7 life instead of 3). At 3 life, the player is extremely vulnerable to any burn or attack next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 9 damage (12 → 3 life)
annotations.betterLine: Block Bolt Hound with Warden of Evos Isle to trade and save 4 damage (12 → 7 life), removing the +1/+0 anthem effect and a key attacker

annotations.description: Activating Spawning Pit to sacrifice a creature when all lands are tapped and no immediate benefit is gained. Neither tapped creature can block, and Wakedancer's morbid can't be triggered usefully since there's not enough mana to cast it this turn. Sacrificing a premium creature (likely Tide Skimmer or Warden) for a single charge counter on Spawning Pit is terrible value.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Spawning Pit to sacrifice a creature during combat with no untapped mana and no way to capitalize on the sacrifice this turn.
annotations.betterLine: Decline to activate Spawning Pit, take the 9 damage (going to 3 life), and preserve both Tide Skimmer and Warden of Evos Isle for future blocking and attacking. These creatures are far more valuable than a single charge counter.

annotations.description: At 5 life, activating Spawning Pit to sacrifice a creature for just one charge counter (needing two to make a token) is a significant mistake. It loses a crucial blocker, and the opponent has Spiteful Prankster which will deal 1 damage when the creature dies. With only two creatures (both flyers) to block against an opponent with multiple attackers, every blocker is critical at 5 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Spawning Pit to sacrifice a creature during combat, gaining a single charge counter.
annotations.betterLine: Either attack with both flyers for 4 damage (opponent at 16 life) while holding up Unsubstantiate for defense, or simply pass to preserve all blockers at 5 life.

annotations.description: Sacrificed Tide Skimmer (2/3) instead of Warden of Evos Isle (2/2). With only one flyer remaining after the sacrifice, Tide Skimmer's card draw ability is inactive either way. However, Tide Skimmer's 2/3 body is better defensively at 5 life than Warden's 2/2, and Warden's cost reduction has no targets in hand (no flying creatures). Keeping the larger body would have been slightly better.
annotations.actionTaken: Sacrificed Tide Skimmer to Spawning Pit, keeping Warden of Evos Isle
annotations.betterLine: Sacrifice Warden of Evos Isle to Spawning Pit, keeping the 2/3 Tide Skimmer as a better defensive body at 5 life

annotations.description: At 4 life facing lethal next turn from opponent's board (Ardoz, Bolt Hound, Irreverent Revelers, Spiteful Prankster), the player passed their postcombat main phase without playing a land or casting any creatures. They had Swamp to play, Disciple of Perdition (1B) and Wakedancer (2B) to cast as additional blockers alongside Warden of Evos Isle. Passing here ends the turn with only one 2/2 blocker against 8+ power of attackers.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in postcombat main phase, ending the turn with unused land drop and uncast creatures.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp, cast Disciple of Perdition (1B) and Wakedancer (2B) to deploy two additional blockers (1/3 and 2/2), giving three total blockers to try to survive the next attack. Hold Unsubstantiate to bounce the biggest attacker during combat.

annotations.description: Targeting opponent's face with Chandra's Pyrohelix instead of killing Warden of Evos Isle (2/2), the only blocker. While the math is likely lethal either way, killing Warden removes all blocking, triggers Spiteful Prankster for 1 extra damage, and plays around potential combat tricks from the opponent's 7-card hand with 6 untapped lands (including blue mana for bounce/tricks).
annotations.actionTaken: Selected opponent (GptOSS Vet) as target for Chandra's Pyrohelix damage
annotations.betterLine: Target Warden of Evos Isle with both points of damage to kill the only blocker, guaranteeing all 4 attackers connect plus a Spiteful Prankster trigger for a clean lethal kill that's harder to interact with.

annotations.description: Cast Fiery Conclusion to kill the opponent's only blocker (Warden of Evos Isle) when the attack was already lethal. With 4 attackers (Ardoz 2/1, Bolt Hound 2/2, Irreverent Revelers 3/2, Spiteful Prankster 4/2) against 1 blocker, and the opponent at 2 life, at least 3 creatures would get through unblocked for far more than 2 damage. Fiery Conclusion required sacrificing a creature and spending 2 mana for no benefit.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Fiery Conclusion, sacrificing a creature to kill Warden of Evos Isle before damage.
annotations.betterLine: Simply let combat damage resolve - the attack was already lethal regardless of how the opponent blocked. No need to sacrifice a creature or spend mana.
